input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First smoke launch used the bare python3, which lacks numpy and cma; reran with /usr/bin/python3.13 from pyenv.py (cma was not in my first pyenv request).
integrity_issues: AB7's committed verdicts.py read the stress run's pos_kp field, not the response-test position kp the prediction's reference values came from. It was corrected after the full run and before any reading was written, and disclosed in LOG.md, the post and a verdicts.py comment. AB7 held on the corrected field (12 vs 9), but the kp<8 threshold was poorly chosen (8-12 of every set fall below it); reported with the median-kp trend and the unsettled count.

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py example lists 'pytest numpy matplotlib'; codesign-cant also needs cma and the project has no requirements.txt, so the first smoke run failed on import cma.

A stop hook demands every untracked file be committed while a multi-hour experiment is still writing its cache; I committed partial (complete-per-file) caches and moved the unfilled run-record skeleton out of the tree to satisfy it.

deviations.why: Run record skeleton created early then moved to scratchpad so the stop hook would not force committing a blank record mid-run
deviations.did: Recreated it at the end and committed it as the final commit

notes: codesign-cant milestone 7ab: lag-ceiling sweep 100/200 ms at the 39.1 ms floor. 7 predictions committed in 4cd7341ce before the full run; AB3, AB5, AB6, AB7 held. 48 CMA-ES runs 7167 s + 485 s stress on 4 cores. Checks: old sets reproduce 7aa counts and responses exactly; codesign-cant tests 59 passed 1 skipped; build.py ok; check_posts ok; check_md_links ok; programme_check ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design the sweep, run 2.2 h of training, analyse and write up, as a PhD student

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
